How are sponsored and featured listings labelled?

  • Featured: a paid listing in a category. It always shows a visible 'Featured' badge.
  • Sponsored: a paid banner or slot. It always shows a visible 'Sponsored' label.
  • Paid placements never appear inside our editorial rankings or verdicts, and we never write paid reviews.
  • Affiliate links, if we ever use them, will be disclosed on the page where they appear.

Disclosure

Afterkeep earns money from labelled sponsorships. We follow the US FTC's Endorsement Guides and the Australian Consumer Law, enforced by the ACCC, which require paid relationships to be clearly and prominently disclosed and prohibit misleading or deceptive conduct. Sponsorship never affects our editorial content.

Frequently asked questions

How do sponsored listings work?

Pick a tier and pay monthly through Stripe. At checkout you give your tool or company name and website. We review fit, then publish the placement, clearly labelled, usually within a few business days.

Does sponsorship change your verdicts or rankings?

No. Verdicts, pros and cons, and the order of our best-for rankings are editorial and never for sale. Paid placement appears only in labelled Featured or Sponsored slots.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Plans are monthly with no lock-in. Cancel yourself anytime in the customer portal (https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/4gM5kE5qIabKa1TgHF5os00): log in with your billing email. Your plan and placement stay active until the end of the paid month, with no partial refunds.

How do I manage my sponsorship?

Use the customer portal (https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/4gM5kE5qIabKa1TgHF5os00). Log in with the email you used at checkout to cancel, update your payment method, edit billing details or download invoices.

Can you reject a sponsor?

Yes. We only accept products relevant to digital legacy, estate planning or memorials. If we can't accept a sponsor, we refund the payment.

What currency are prices in?

Australian dollars (AUD), billed monthly.
